cac:TenderingCriterion.cbc:Name: Participation in a criminal organisation
cac:TenderingCriterion.cbc:Description: Has the economic operator itself or any person who is a member of its administrative, management or supervisory body or has powers of representation, decision or control therein been the subject of a conviction by final judgment for participation in a criminal organisation, by a conviction rendered at the most five years ago or in which an exclusion period set out directly in the conviction continues to be applicable? As defined in Article 2 of Council Framework Decision 2008/841/JHA of 24 October 2008 on the fight against organised crime (OJ L 300, 11.11.2008, p. 42).

cac:SubTenderingCriterion.cbc:Name: Participation in a criminal organisation
cac:SubTenderingCriterion.cbc:Description: Has any person of the economic operator listed in Article 80, paragraph 3, of the Legislative Decree no. 50/2016 been convicted by a sentence that has the force of res judicata, or by a criminal order against which no appeal lies, or by a sentence of application of punishment upon request pursuant to Article 444 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, for crimes committed or attempted referred to in Article 416, 416-bis of the Penal Code or for crimes committed using the conditions set out in the Article 416-bis or in order to facilitate the activity of the associations provided for by the same article, as well as for crimes, committed or attempted, provided for by Article 74 of Decree of the President of the Republic No. 309/1990, by Article 291-quater of the Decree of the President of the Republic No. 43/1973 and Article 260 of Legislative Decree No. 152/2006, relating to participation in a criminal organisation as defined in Article 2 of Council Framework Decision 2008/841/JHA? (The economic operator does not have to declare the conviction if: the exclusion period set out directly in the judgment or in the decree or provided for by Article 80, paragraph 10 and 10-bis of the Legislative Decree No. 50/2016 has ended; the offence was decriminalised; the rehabilitation has been deemed to have occurred; the permanent accessory penalty has been deemed extinct provided for by Articolo 179, paragraph 7 of the Penal Code; the conviction was declared spent; the conviction has been overturned).
